verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of version history, change review, or rollback for a user's own Zaps or automations. The only versioning evidence covers the lifecycle of partner integration versions on the Developer Platform, which is a different capability. Reviewing AI troubleshooting instructions or MCP mode changes is an adjacent feature, not automation version control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
